# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

In the interest of fostering an open and welcoming environment, we as contributors and maintainers pledge to making participation in our project and our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, and religion.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment for our community:

- **Be friendly and patient**: Welcome newcomers and be patient with questions, even if they seem basic.
- **Be respectful**: Value different opinions, viewpoints, and experiences. Disagree agreeably.
- **Be collaborative**: Work together to find the best solutions. Help others succeed.
- **Be constructive**: Provide helpful feedback and suggest improvements rather than just criticizing.
- **Use inclusive language**: Avoid exclusive or offensive language that may alienate others.

Examples of unacceptable behavior:

- **Harassment** of any kind
- **Exclusionary** jokes or comments
- **Trolling** or inflammatory comments
- **Personal or political attacks**
- **Publishing others' private information** (doxxing) without explicit permission
- **Other conduct** which could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional setting

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies within all project spaces, including but not limited to:
- Repository source code and documentation
- Issue trackers and pull requests
- Chat rooms, mailing lists, and social media channels
- Event venues and meetups related to the project

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive, harassing, or otherwise unacceptable behavior may be reported by opening an issue or contacting the project team at reach@nebula-cli.com. All complaints will be investigated and will result in a response that is deemed necessary and appropriate to the circumstances.

Project maintainers have the right to remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, issues, edits, pulls, and other contributions that are not aligned with this Code of Conduct. Project maintainers who have received complaints about behavior in good faith will be handled fairly, consistently, and transparently.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Convenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/), version 2.1, available at https://www.contributor-covenant.org/2/1/code_of_conduct.html.
